simulation_results.mul32_sim: PASS signed 32x32 pipelined multiplier: 18873 full-range products, signed extremes and enable stalls.
simulation_results.brown_sim: PASS Brown inverse mapper: 81036 integer Python golden rays, identity/radial/tangential/overflow, signed Q9.22 math, explicit black domain, configuration drain, tagged output backpressure and mid-pipeline reset recovery.
simulation_results.brown_remap_sim: PASS composed Brown -> DDR neighbours -> bilinear: 19086 Python golden queries, four neighbours and RGB888 each compared; signed floor, borders, burst boundaries, cache conflicts, bank switch, same-bank new frame, variable DDR stalls, output backpressure, malformed RLAST/RID, timeout, unsolicited responses and mid-burst reset recovery.

pixel_format: source RGB565 expanded by bit replication to RGB888
coordinates: Q15.8 pixels and focal lengths, Q1.30 inverse focal, Q9.22 rays/coefficients
limits: Standalone synthetic test shell only; actual DDR PHY/capture/HDMI integration timing and board correction remain unverified. No fisheye/rotation FPGA datapath. One ray/cycle describes coordinate arithmetic, not the serial DDR sampler or full-frame FPS.
next: Connect an output frame store and burst-owner read/write arbiters; export real camera frames, calibrate and compare held-out Brown/fisheye error.
